change_under_test.summary: Attempts 1-3's fixes, plus runtime envelopes sized from a measurement instead of a guess. Measured with scripts/diagnostic_019_timing.py: SmolAgents/019 needs 1480 s end to end with generous per-call budgets. At the 900 s case deadline its judge votes consumed the whole budget with two 480 s call timeouts, the tracer and defense never started, and the row resolved non-authoritative, which froze the defect-injection audit because it must not certify a gate rejection it could not score. Raised: case deadline 900->3600, per-attempt 240->300, per-call total 480->900, and (in this attempt's config only) the cycle deadline 7200->14400, since that case appears in three sequential arm evaluations per cycle. These are fail-closed bounding envelopes: they can only convert an unmeasurable row into a measured one and cannot change any admission threshold, gate, split, seed or label.
